verdict.rationale: The Secretary of State documents a print-and-mail option for Annual Reports via the Annual Report Wizard, and runs a forms library (e.g., the Appointment of New Registered Agent form), so a paper rail exists for at least some filings. The evidence never shows the exact mailing address, fax number, or a complete paper form set for formation and maintenance filings. Missing for 10: published mailing address, fax number, and confirmation of paper forms for formation and other maintenance filings.
